title: JAB — The Best of the Monster Games
description: Explore a maze, evade Jabberwockies, and set timed explosive drops.
versionOrder: The website keeps one source file. Earlier saves are in Git history: tags jab-v01 through jab-v03 hold the tape16a forms and jab-v05 holds the disk form. Their inferred order follows local save order; tape numbers alone do not establish chronology. The damaged tape16a save 5 is preserved separately and is not filled from any complete save.
